source_metadata.title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of cardiovascular disease in patients with diabetes

formal_guidance.representation: Formal guideline recommendations are atom_kind='other' with guideline_recommendation, recommendation-table, class, and level tags because the recovered project pattern has no dedicated guideline recommendation atom kind.

groups.canonical_statement: Empagliflozin or dapagliflozin are recommended in patients with T2DM and LVEF >40% (HFmrEF and HFpEF) to reduce the risk of HF hospitalization or CV death.

duplicate_review.finding: One recommendation is repeated in separate formal recommendation tables and is retained twice because the source presents it as two independently located formal guidance rows.

consistency_review.finding: Recommendation strength and evidence level are preserved in tags. Underlying trial findings summarized by the guideline were used for SEA appraisal but were not promoted to primary-study LiteratureAtoms.

validation_boundary: The authoritative project Pydantic model, sufficiency validator, serialization schema, and exact SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable. Structural validation therefore used a strict local Pydantic contract reconstructed from current validated project guideline artifacts, with JSON Schema generated from that contract and a local sufficiency check for the extracted atom kinds. This report does not claim execution of the unavailable authoritative project code.
schema_gaps: The recovered LiteratureAtom pattern has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind.
Recommendation class and level of evidence are preserved as tags rather than dedicated typed fields.
The evaluated source is a guideline. Results from cited trials remain secondary evidence unless the primary trial publication is extracted separately.
extraction_limitations: The 228-page evidence-table packet was used for evidence reconciliation and appraisal, not atomized row by row as primary-study evidence.
The 37-page supplement was used for SCORE2-Diabetes, trial-table, pharmacology, and workflow reconciliation rather than converted into separate primary-study atoms.
The 90-page declaration-of-interest packet was summarized at the governance level rather than converted into one atom per expert-year relationship.
Bibliography entries were not atomized. They are exported separately in Markdown with source-specific numbering.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human verification step is represented.
